messages:
mia: Quick pitch  micro-launch to test activation velocity. 15-min lightning demo + 36h credit spike. Split test two onboarding nudges: 'playbook-first' vs 'hands-on-first'. Route signups into flows with different prompt packs and follow-up cadence. Goal: increase run-first-prompt < 24h.
aj: Love it. Key metrics: demo->signup, signup->first_prompt_run (hrs), 7-day retention. Can analytics create a simple leader board by cohort?
theo: Copy angles draft: playbook-first = "Results-first: quick recipes teams can copy." hands-on-first = "Launcher-first: run the demo in your stack, 1-click." CTAs: 'Claim seed credits' vs 'Run demo now'.
cel: Routing plan: add utm=velA|velB on links, auto-assign cohort field. SDR rule: company email + tokens_7d>=800 => flag as hot. SLA: first touch <=5h. Ops?
ops-bot: Routing queued. Example API call: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/routes -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","utm":"velA"}'
``` -> sets user.cohort=velA and posts to #sales-inbound. :white_check_mark:
mia: Onboarding artifacts: playbook pack = 4 short recipes (support triage, meeting notes, summarizer, product Q&A). Launcher pack = 4 runnable examples + quick infra notes. Tag in /docs/marketing/vel-1923456789/.
aj: Analytics events: emit 'first_prompt_run', 'seed_credit_granted', 'template_download' with cohort property. Add tiny survey after first run: did it meet expectations? yes/no.
theo: Landing variants: short demo embed + tiny checklist. Add hidden field 'use_case' for SDR context. Also include a tiny toggle for 'I use private infra' to route enterprise leads separately.
cel: SDR flow: for hot leads, 1) ping Slack #sales-inbound, 2) send intro email within SLA, 3) offer 30-min workshop. Template: "Congrats on launching with Redwood  want a quick setup call?"
ops-bot: Tracking snippet: <script>track('first_prompt_run',{cohort:'velA'});</script> and credit grant example: <script>emit('seed_credit_granted',{cohort:'velA',amount:1500});</script>
mia: Timeline: creatives + landing by Thu EOD, routing live Fri AM, demo Mon 11am PT, credit spike live at signup. Who's moderating demo?
aj: I can moderate; theo demos retrieval and cost slides. cel will own SDR handoff.
theo: Also propose an experiment variant to gate credits until first prompt run to measure lift from deferred incentive. Thoughts?
mia: Good idea. Add third bucket velC to withhold credits until run. We'll need clear messaging so folks don't churn.
cel: For routing: velC users get a friendly nudge at 24h with a single-run challenge. If no run in 48h, automatic email sequence.
ops-bot: Webhook configured to post qualified leads: ```json
{"email":"{{email}}","cohort":"velA","use_case":"support","tokens_7d":1200}
``` 
mia: Great. I'll post final copy here and upload prompt packs. Keep replies here for quick signoff. :rocket:
